page.notes: Page is blurred and heavily mottled, especially in the second paragraph. "praecludatur" and "videas" are uncertain. The Greek word after "respondet Socinus" (the Greek term for idolatry, as far as it can be seen) is not legible, so it is marked as illegible. "col.2." after the first paragraph is printed inline and may be a column reference; I placed it at the end of that paragraph. The "§. 96. 4." opening is printed as a section marker. Phrases set in italic are marked with <i>; the exact extent of italics is uncertain in the blur.
